analyst.en: Brackenford have dominated possession, 63% to 37%, with 510 passes to 299. The biggest driver was clock running down, cutting their win chance from 22% to 17% as the draw rose to 71%.

home.en: Hold tight, Rangers fans. One red card and brave defending kept us level, finish strong.
home.es: Ánimo, aficionados de Rangers. Roja y defensa valiente nos mantienen nivelados, rematad con fuerza.
home.pt: Força, torcedores do Rangers. Um vermelho e defesa valente mantiveram o empate, terminem fortes.
home.fr: Courage, supporters des Rangers. Un rouge et une grosse défense nous maintiennent à égalité, finissez forts.

away.en: Keep believing, City fans. You control most of the ball, push for a late winner.
away.es: Seguid creyendo, aficionados del City. Tenéis la mayor parte del balón, buscad el gol tardío.
away.pt: Continuem a acreditar, torcedores do City. Vocês controlam a maior parte da bola, busquem o gol tardio.
away.fr: Gardez foi, supporters du City. Vous contrôlez la plupart du ballon, poussez pour un but tardif.

headline.en: Late strike lifts Eastholme into command
headline.es: Gol tardío pone a Eastholme al mando
headline.pt: Gol no fim coloca Eastholme na frente

story.en: Adam Penke's 82nd minute goal turns the match, Eastholme's win chance jumps from 12% to 83%. They lead 2-1 despite having had a red card.
story.es: El gol de Adam Penke al minuto 82 cambia todo, la probabilidad de victoria de Eastholme sube de 12% a 83%. Mandan 2-1 pese a haber recibido una tarjeta roja.
story.pt: O gol de Adam Penke aos 82 minutos virou o jogo, a chance de vitória do Eastholme salta de 12% para 83%. Vencem por 2-1 apesar de um cartão vermelho.
story.fr: Le but d'Adam Penke à la 82e minute fait basculer la rencontre, la probabilité de victoire d'Eastholme passe de 12 % à 83 %. Ils mènent 2-1 malgré un carton rouge.

analyst.en: xG 1.25 to 0.46, Eastholme down in possession 37% to 63% but better finishing. The 82nd minute goal was the biggest driver, lifting win probability from 12% to 83%.

home.en: Lovely. Hold tight, defend smart, finish the job in the last eight. Biscuits for everyone.
home.es: Estupendo. Aguantad, defended con cabeza, rematad el trabajo en los últimos ocho minutos. Galletas para todos.
home.pt: Maravilha. Segura a defesa, joga com cabeça, fecha o jogo nos oito finais. Biscoitos para todos.
home.fr: Superbe. Tenez bon, défendez intelligemment, concluez dans les huit dernières minutes. Biscuits pour tous.

away.en: Keep your heads up, we created chances. Push for a late equalizer, proud of the fight.
away.es: Cabezas arriba, generamos oportunidades. Empujad por el empate tardío, orgullosos de la pelea.
away.pt: Cabeças erguidas, criamos oportunidades. Forcem o empate no final, orgulhosos da luta.
away.fr: Gardez la tête haute, nous avons eu des occasions. Poussez pour l’égalisation tardive, fiers du combat.

headline.en: Late lead holds as time runs out
headline.es: Liderato aguanta cuando se acaba el tiempo
headline.pt: Vantagem resiste com o tempo a acabar

story.en: Eastholme Rangers see their win chance rise from 83% to 91% at 89', a late clock swing after Adam Penke's 82' winner. Eastholme had a player sent off earlier, but the lead looks secure.
story.es: Las Eastholme Rangers ven su probabilidad de victoria subir del 83% al 91% en el 89', un giro por el reloj tras el gol decisivo de Adam Penke en el 82'. Eastholme tuvo una expulsión antes, pero la ventaja parece segura.
story.pt: O Eastholme Rangers vêem sua chance de vitória subir de 83% para 91% aos 89', uma mudança por causa do tempo após o gol decisivo de Adam Penke aos 82'. O Eastholme teve um jogador expulso antes, mas a vantagem parece segura.
story.fr: Eastholme Rangers voient leur chance de victoire passer de 83% à 91% à la 89e, un basculement dû au temps après le but décisif d'Adam Penke à la 82e. Eastholme a eu un joueur expulsé auparavant, mais l'avance semble tenue.

analyst.en: Eastholme lead 2-1 with xG 1.25 to 0.46, possession 35% to 65%, but more clinical. Biggest driver of the points swing was the clock running down, worth +8.0 points, shrinking comeback chances.

home.en: Hold tight, favorites. Clock’s on our side, finish this with grit.
home.es: Aguantad, favoritos. El reloj nos ayuda, finiquitad con coraje.
home.pt: Aguentem, favoritos. O tempo está a nosso favor, segurem com fibra.
home.fr: Tenez bon, favoris. Le temps joue pour nous, finissez avec courage.

away.en: Keep belief, fans. Push for a late miracle, never say die.
away.es: Manteneos en la fe, aficionados. Buscad el milagro hasta el final.
away.pt: Mantenham a fé, torcedores. Lutem por um milagre até o fim.
away.fr: Gardez la foi, supporters. Cherchez le miracle jusqu au bout.

headline.en: Eastholme clinches it as clock runs out
headline.es: Eastholme sella la victoria con el tiempo
headline.pt: Eastholme garante a vitória no apagar do relógio
headline.fr: Eastholme scelle la victoire en fin de match

story.en: Eastholme Rangers held on after Adam Penke's 82nd-minute goal. Win chance for Eastholme jumps from 91% to 100%, the clock running down sealed it. Eastholme had a red card.
story.es: Eastholme Rangers aguantó tras el gol de Adam Penke al minuto 82. La probabilidad de victoria de Eastholme sube de 91% a 100%, el reloj cerró el partido. Eastholme tuvo una tarjeta roja.
story.pt: Eastholme Rangers resistiu depois do gol de Adam Penke aos 82 minutos. A chance de vitória do Eastholme sobe de 91% para 100%, o tempo matou a reação. Eastholme teve um cartão vermelho.
story.fr: Eastholme Rangers a tenu bon après le but d'Adam Penke à la 82e minute. Les chances de victoire d'Eastholme passent de 91 % à 100 %, le temps a scellé l'issue. Eastholme a reçu un carton rouge.

analyst.en: Eastholme had 35% possession, 11 shots, xG 1.26 to Brackenford's xG 0.46. The biggest driver was clock running down, adding nine points after the 82nd minute goal.

home.en: You held tight, favorites and gutsy. That late goal and the clock sealed it. Well done.
home.es: Aguantasteis con coraje, favoritos y con temple. Ese gol tardío y el reloj lo sellaron. Bien hecho.
home.pt: Vocês aguentaram com raça, favoritos e firmes. Esse gol no fim e o tempo selaram. Parabéns.
home.fr: Vous avez tenu bon, favoris et courageux. Ce but tardif et le temps ont scellé tout. Bravo.

away.en: You controlled more of the ball, but time ran out. Heads up, keep building.
away.es: Tuvisteis más balón, pero se acabó el tiempo. Arriba las cabezas, seguid construyendo.
away.pt: Vocês controlaram mais a bola, mas o tempo acabou. Cabeças erguidas, continuem construindo.
away.fr: Vous avez eu plus le ballon, mais le temps a manqué. Tenez bon, continuez à construire.
